C002:144.summary: Risk flags identified: elevated cardiovascular strain, sleep deficit, acute radiation exposure, isolation stress, increased inflammatory marker.
drivers: Cardiovascular strain: resting HR elevated (70 bpm) and HRV depressed (50 ms)
Sleep duration below 6h for consecutive sols (avg 5.4h)
Solar particle event acute radiation spike (9.0 mSv)
Reported isolation stress and mood rating decline

suggestedActions.title: Solar Particle Event Habitat Storm Shelter
suggestedActions.protocol: Remain in designated habitat storm shelter module until active dosimeter measures normal transit baseline (<2.0 mSv/day); rescheduling pending EVA spacewalk activities suggested for flight surgeon review.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Radiation Health Bio-Protection Guidelines

suggestedActions.title: Autonomic Deconditioning and Fluid Rebalancing
suggestedActions.protocol: Ingestion of monitored fluid and electrolyte countermeasure solutions and use of lower body compression garments suggested for flight surgeon review to relieve cardiac strain.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Cardiovascular Deconditioning and Autonomic Regulation

suggestedActions.title: Cardiac Pacing and Workload Adjustment
suggestedActions.protocol: Operational physical workload reduction and dedicated restorative rest periods suggested for flight surgeon review to support autonomic recovery.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Cardiovascular Deconditioning and Autonomic Regulation

C002:144.disclaimer: This output provides risk flags and suggested countermeasures only. It does not constitute a medical diagnosis or treatment plan. Consult the flight surgeon when contact is possible.

C001:140.summary: Elevated inflammatory biomarker response (CRP) and cumulative sleep deficit identified as risk drivers for crew member C001.

suggestedActions.title: Circadian & Blue-Enriched Light Therapy
suggestedActions.protocol: Implement 30-minute high-intensity blue-enriched light therapy upon waking to stabilize circadian entrainment; strict dark and quiet opportunity windows suggested for flight surgeon review.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Fatigue Management and Countermeasures

suggestedActions.title: Sleep Hygiene and Opportunity Scheduling
suggestedActions.protocol: Maintain an 8.5-hour quiet rest opportunity schedule with dimmed cabin ambient lighting; non-critical task deferrals suggested for flight surgeon review.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Fatigue Management and Behavioral Health

suggestedActions.title: Deferral of Extravehicular Activities
suggestedActions.protocol: Postpone pending extravehicular spacewalks during elevated space radiation conditions; limiting personnel proximity to thinly shielded outer habitat hulls suggested for flight surgeon review.
suggestedActions.source: NASA HRP: Space Radiation Bio-Protection Protocols

C001:140.disclaimer: This guidance is advisory only; consult the flight surgeon when contact is possible.
